description: This file defines the Coupon model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling coupon retrieval, validation, product/category associations, and history management.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Model class for managing coupons, including retrieval, validation, product/category associations, and history logging.

methods.name: getCoupon
methods.description: Retrieves coupon details if valid and applicable based on code, date, usage limits, customer login status, and product/category restrictions.

methods.name: getCouponByCode
methods.description: Fetches coupon record from database by code where status is active.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves list of product IDs associated with a specific coupon.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves list of category IDs associated with a specific coupon.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Inserts a new coupon usage record into the coupon history table.

methods.name: deleteHistoriesByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes coupon history records associated with a specific order ID.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns total count of coupon history records for a given coupon.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByCustomerId
methods.description: Returns total count of coupon history records for a specific coupon and customer.
